name: Query for Exact Value
hint: A varying robot sensor reading is compared using exact equality. Noise and floating-point precision make an exact match rare or unstable, so the response may fail or flicker.
instruction: Compare against a tolerance, threshold, or interval instead of one exact value, accounting for the expected measurement noise.

examples.label: Error
examples.scratchblocks:
when on-board button [A v] :: events hat
if <(@codeyB loudness :: sensing) = (50)> then
say [Loud]
end
